document.cover:
# Relay interface board

Two 24 V DC relays switch two contactor coils from PLC outputs. Input header -J1 takes the
PLC outputs and the coil return; output header -J2 carries the relay common and the two
normally open contacts.
document.notes: The relay coils carry no flyback diode: they are small, and the PLC output module switches them.

document.cover:
# Two-pump station, system

Project EX-1, revision 1.1.

The station: the pump cabinet +C1 and, external to it (+EXT), the two pump motors, the network
switch and the upstream distribution board's terminals, joined by their cables.
document.notes: The cable drawings show every core and both ends of each cable outside the cabinet.

document.cover:
# Pump cabinet

Two direct-on-line motor starters, controlled and monitored by a WAGO 750 PLC through a
relay interface board.
document.notes:
The upstream board protects the incoming cable with a C16 breaker. The cable lands there on
terminals +EXT-X0, the only part of the upstream board in this model.

The relay interface board -U2 has its own drawing set. These pages show it only as its two headers
inside a dash-dot outline.
